exposure: Race (Black, White, Hispanic, American Indian/Alaska Native)
outcome: Severe Maternal Morbidity secondary to pre-eclampsia (with and without transfusion)
cohort: The study included over 36,000 deliveries from 2019 to 2020 within 41 Military treatment facilities across the U.S. Department of Defense.
finding: While Black women experienced an increased risk of overall severe maternal morbidity compared to White women, the risk of severe maternal morbidity related to pre-eclampsia showed no significant racial difference within the Military healthcare system.
cross-section timing: Data collected from deliveries occurring between 2019 and 2020
